Step:  
08-06-1633 is June 8, 1633 (DD-MM-YYYY).  
33 weeks and 1 day = 33 × 7 + 1 = 232 days.  
Subtract 232 days from June 8, 1633:  

1633 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days before June 8 in 1633: Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + 8 days in June = 31+28+31+30+31+8 = 159 days.  
So June 8 is day 159 of the year.  

Subtract 232 days: go back into previous year.  
159 − 232 = −73 days from start of 1633.  
Add 365 days of 1632 (leap year? 1632 divisible by 4, yes, leap year) → 365 − 73 = 292 days into 1632.  

Day 292 of leap year 1632:  
Jan 31 (31), Feb 29 (60), Mar 31 (91), Apr 30 (121), May 31 (152), Jun 30 (182), Jul 31 (213), Aug 31 (244), Sep 30 (274).  
292 − 274 = 18 days into October → October 18, 1632.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1632-10-18
